subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: The Pattern of Descent
description: Learn The Pattern of Descent in one minute.

hook.text: Inanna, Orpheus, Persephone, Izanagi—heroes go down into death and come back changed. The pattern repeats.

buildup.text: The descent is always voluntary. The hero chooses to face death, not wait for it.

discovery.text: What's lost below can never be fully recovered. Every return carries grief, compromise, or sacrifice.

twist.text: The descent isn't about the dead. It's about the living. Going below teaches what life truly costs.

climax.text: Psychology adopted this. Jung called it confronting the shadow. Therapy is a modern descent myth.

punchline.text: Go down to grow up. That's the rule.

quiz.question: What is the common outcome of underworld descent myths?
options: Something is always lost or sacrificed
